title: Shaam Day Rawan Tay Haye Beemar Turda Jaway
body:
Qaid Na Naal Nay Meray, Fatima Jaiyan Nay, Ro Rokay Dasda Jaaway.
<<DIVIDER>>
Fikaar Masooma Di Abid Noon Sataundi Rehndi
Joondi Ay Ya Margayi Ay Saktiya Sayndi
Saaf Akhiyan Da Lahoo Karkay, Maur Kay Tauq Wali
Gaardan Noon Tak Da Jaaway.
<<DIVIDER>>
Vad Gaye Bheer Bazaari Tay Qayamat Ho Gaye
Ayee Awaaz Haye Abid Sakina Koh Gaye
Jeevain Akbar Di Laash Nu, Reya Baba Labda
Enj Behn Labda Jaway
<<DIVIDER>>
Behriyaan Tauq Tay Zanjeer Dah Ghum Koyi Nahin
Khoon Akhiyaan Chon Do Gaya Jadon Shimr Layeen
Chadar-e-Sani-e-Zahra, Samnay Abid Day
Lehra Kay Hasda Jaway.
<<DIVIDER>>
Ehday Akbar Da Vi Sir Naizay Tay Charaya Ay
Kyun Nah Beemar Khoon Roway Oh Naiza Tak Kay
Veer Day Sir Nu Muhari, Naal Akhiyaan Day Rahi
Ro Ro Kay Chum Da Jaway.
<<DIVIDER>>
Naal Phuphiyan Nay Bazaran Wich Haye Nangay Payri
Kivain Chun Lay Na Rasteyan Chon O Kanday Qaidi
Khar Rawaan Di Chunan Layi Payr Akbar Abid
Kandeyan Tay Rakhda Jaway.
